spectrum_interpretation: One-sided Hann fluctuation PSD, DC removed; static order is separate. Finite-window apparent width is not intrinsic linewidth. Gamma cancellation is not absence of finite-q coherence. Images/regions characterize amplitude morphology, not phase-coherent domain radii.

scalability.scope: Measured throughput/memory only, not a stationary million-site phase or spectrum.

affected_static_channel4.scope: Only the four pumped cases dominated by a static mean were rerun; the selected order field is now the dominant static/driven channel.

superseded_extraction_attempt.cause: Post-run region lookup incorrectly required optional material field; corrected to the existing NiH default before the final four-case natural exit0.

images.caption: Occupied sites (gray/black) and real x displacement (red/blue, scale ±0.25 A), reference (001) slice.
Occupied sites (gray/black) and real x displacement (red/blue, scale ±0.25 A), reference (001) slice.

Rows: deepest mobile and interface layer. Columns: minimum contrast eigenvalue (display scale ±1 eV/A²), demodulated displacement norm (yellow, scale0.15 A), real pump-polarized quadrature (red/blue, scale ±0.25 A). Normal-only extrapolated map; not physical PdD instability.
